provenance.paper_title: Scaling Up and Distilling Down: Language-Guided Robot Skill Acquisition
provenance.notes: Native source-layout reconstruction of flattened original. Ordinary labels and code are typeable. Diagram shapes and logical arrows are native. Explicitly bounded source photographs, icons and mathematical formula inserts retain raster pixels. Font metrics and path coordinates are measured approximations. Figure4 is the paper’s policy-distillation architecture. Two observation image assets stop above their name strips; the observation labels exist only as native text and cannot leave hidden original lettering. The robot action illustration includes internal motion annotations as raster; all architecture arrows are native.
